messages:
mira: Quick sync  we need to finish the AWS marketplace staging submission this week. Checklist: hero image (1024x512), logo (512x512), SKU mapping for trial/payg/dedicated, onboarding one-time SKU, EULA+DPA links, and support contact. Who takes what?

alex: Ill own SKU mapping & pricing fields. Will prepare CSV and include tax notes.

jonah: I'll pull the final hero from marketing and verify copy. @laura do you have exports?

laura: Yup. I have hero_v4.png and logo_512.png in s3://redwood-marketing/marketplace/. Will export alternate sizes if AWS asks. Alt text coming.

marketplace-bot: Heads-up: Required fields missing: Pricing Model Details, Support Contact. See checklist: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/listing/checklist/xyz

mira: Legal flagged we cannot say "SLA-backed" for hosted listing unless SLA attached. Keep hosted blurb high level.

alex: Draft SKU CSV (preview):
sku,plan_name,term,price
RW-MKT-TRIAL,Hosted API - 30d Trial,trial,0
RW-MKT-PAYG,Hosted API - PayG,monthly,per_token
RW-MKT-DED,Dedicated - Monthly,commit,monthly
RW-MKT-ONB,Onboarding - One-time,onetim,contact_us
I'll upload to partnerships/marketplace-assets/sku-mapping.csv and add EU VAT flags.

jonah: Short blurb suggestion: "Redwood Inference  predictable, high-performance LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Includes a 30-day trial." (using "Includes" per compliance).

laura: Alt text: "Redwood Inference dashboard showing latency and cost charts". Uploaded hero_1024.png and logo_512.png. No promotional overlays.

legal: Legal here  EULA: https://legal.redwood.ai/eula-v2, DPA: https://legal.redwood.ai/dpa-v1. Confirmed: no SLA language in hosted copy.

mira: marketplace-support@redwood.ai as support contact?

sam_k: yes please, forwarding to support ops. I'll prep co-marketing blurb separately.

marketplace-bot: Upload logged: s3://redwood-marketing/marketplace/hero_1024.png at 1768740300 by laura

alex: CSV uploaded (v1). Note: onboarding SKU left price empty and marked as "contact us". Tax note: EU_VAT_APPLIES=true for conversions from trial.

jonah: I'll run the short blurb past compliance; will post edits by EOD.

mira: plan: finalize assets + CSV tonight, submit to AWS staging tomorrow AM. If anything else, flag now. Thanks all! :tada:
